stimulus.content: Continuous-flow bioreactor testing evaluated Eichhornia crassipes bioaccumulation of Lead (Pb2+) over 14 days under controlled environmental parameters (pH 6.5, 22°C). Root necrosis and organic exudate leakage were registered during the final phase.

stimulus.notes: Regulatory discharge threshold for Pb2+ is 0.05 mg/L; root tissue saturation threshold occurs at 45 mg Pb2+/g dry biomass.

tasks.title: Assessment of Eutrophication Remediation via Calcium Peroxide Dosing
tasks.prompt: Evaluate the reliability and methodological limitations of using calcium peroxide (CaO2) chemical dosing to remediate dissolved oxygen depletion in urban runoff ponds based on the experimental protocol log.

stimulus.title: Experimental Protocol Log: Dissolved Oxygen (DO) Recovery & Phytoplankton Response
stimulus.content: Field trial logs recorded DO concentrations (mg/L) and cyanobacterial cell density (cells/mL) at 48-hour intervals post-dosing with 15 g/m³ CaO2 in a closed mesocosm system under ambient sunlight (22°C - 26°C).
keyPoints: Baseline (0h): DO = 2.1 mg/L (hypoxic), Cyanobacteria = 1.4 × 10^5 cells/mL.
48h Post-Dosing: DO spiked to 8.9 mg/L (+323%); Cyanobacteria dropped to 3.2 × 10^3 cells/mL.
96h Post-Dosing: DO declined to 4.3 mg/L; sudden pH increase observed from 7.2 to 9.6 due to hydroxide accumulation.
Anomaly observed: Rebound in pH-tolerant chlorophytes at 120h, alongside localized macroinvertebrate mortality.
stimulus.notes: Mesocosm volume = 5,000 L. Light intensity was unmonitored between 48h and 96h due to optical sensor failure.
